tools.title: Gravitee API Management
tools.summary: API gateway and management platform for REST, event-driven and AI APIs.

servers.name: Gravitee APIM MCP Server

settings.name: management_api_host
settings.description: Gravitee: your Management API host, without https://

servers.capabilities: Management API v2 APIs surface: create, import, update and deploy APIs, plans, subscriptions, members, analytics, logs, health and scoring.
servers.scopes: The APIM service user's organisation and environment roles; the read, write and dangerous scopes mount tool groups. Consent: Create a dedicated service user and a personal token.

tools.notes: The README passes the token with --bearer-auth; the server also reads GRAVITEEAPIM_BEARER_AUTH (src/lib/security.ts), which keeps it out of the arguments. Version 0.2.1 targets APIM 4.12; documentation.gravitee.io describes it for APIM 4.9+.

tools.title: Kong Konnect
tools.summary: API platform: Kong Gateway, Konnect control planes, analytics and Dev Portal.

servers.name: Kong Konnect MCP Server
servers.capabilities: Search, get_schema and execute over Konnect resources: gateway entities, analytics, debug sessions, Kong docs and Dev Portal pages and snippets.
servers.scopes: The Konnect personal or system account access token's permissions. Consent: Use a Konnect PAT as a bearer token, or sign in with OAuth where the client supports it; admins can turn MCP off in AI Settings.

tools.notes: Konnect only: no MCP server for a self-managed Kong Gateway found. Regional endpoints (us, eu, au, in .mcp.konghq.com) also exist. The docs list a Public Beta (2025-12-19) but no current status. The older Kong/mcp-konnect repository is archived.

tools.title: Apigee
tools.summary: Google Cloud API management platform, with Apigee API hub as the API catalogue.

servers.name: Apigee API hub remote MCP server
servers.capabilities: Create, update and query APIs, versions, specs and deployments in Apigee API hub.
servers.access: Read or write, depending on the server configuration, the tools enabled or the consent given.
servers.scopes: roles/mcp.toolUser plus roles/apihub.viewer, editor or admin; OAuth scopes apihub.readonly or apihub.readwrite. Consent: Sign in with Google (IAM); API keys are not accepted.

tools.notes: The server covers API hub only: no Google MCP server for managing Apigee proxies, products or environments found on 2026-11-24. Apigee's own MCP feature exposes your APIs as MCP tools instead. Regional endpoint: apihub.REGION.rep.googleapis.com/mcp; no launch stage stated.
